annotation.title_clean: Engagements on Canada's next AI Strategy: Summary of Inputs
annotation.title_en: Engagements on Canada's next AI Strategy: Summary of Inputs
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED)
annotation.summary_en: ISED Canada summarises inputs to its 2025 consultation on a renewed national AI strategy: over 11,300 respondents and 32 Task Force reports across eight pillars. Themes include talent, adoption, sovereign infrastructure, public trust, risk-based regulation, security and liability. General AI focus with no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Largest consultation in ISED history: 11,300+ participants, 64,600 responses to 26 questions on eight pillars
32 AI Strategy Task Force reports informed the summary
Key themes: risk-based regulation, transparent governance, sovereign infrastructure, AI literacy, security and liability laws
Recommends AI assurance labs, governance councils and a national AI talent strategy
Responses were analysed using LLMs with human validation
